entries.text: A new automatic Kings Logistics Milestone Detector has been introduced.
The system automatically monitors the official Kings Logistics TruckersMP member count and detects milestones in 50-member steps from 150 up to 1,000 members.
Every new milestone is automatically announced in Kings News and can notify members with the News Notifications role.
Reached milestones are permanently remembered to prevent duplicate announcements if the member count later drops and reaches the same milestone again.
A new Kings Logistics Changelog automation system has been introduced.
Future changelogs can automatically receive their KL number, publication date and Discord formatting.
Published changelogs are archived automatically and the system remembers the next KL number for future updates.
The system also protects Discord's message limit and can split larger changelogs into multiple messages when required.
Introduced the Kings Central Overview, combining live member, activity, milestone and changelog information in one automatically updated Discord overview.

Since 30 August 2026, Kings Logistics has undergone one of its largest organisation-wide improvement phases. This major update covers changes already live as well as systems now defined and being introduced step by step. The focus is a clearer, more professional and future-ready Kings Family.

Refreshed the Kings visual direction, updated banners, headers and graphics, and established Kings Bright Blue (#182DFF) for a consistent Discord role-icon family. A long-term profile Asset System is being developed for Drivers, Staff, Leadership, Departments, Awards and Loyalty. Personalised profile assets are currently reserved for Leadership / High Staff.

Kings is being structured as a multi-platform ETS2 & ATS VTC rather than TruckersMP-only. TruckersMP and HaulMP are currently supported. General rules, information, applications and Driver systems are becoming platform-neutral, while platform-specific requirements remain where necessary.

Rewritten the Community Rules with clearer guidance on respect, conduct, divisive discussions, hate and prohibited content, privacy, advertising, spam, voice channels, recording, streaming, Staff and Ticket processes, consequences and reviews. The rules now address the wider Kings community.

Updated the About Kings information to reflect an international ETS2 & ATS VTC, supported multiplayer platforms and the wider Kings Family. We focus on teamwork, friendship, respect, fairness and unity, rather than fixed Driver counts or a single platform status.

Combined the former Welcome to Kings area and Driver Guidelines into one central Driver Handbook (<#1558326544001269800>). It brings together expectations, behaviour, driving rules, Kings representation, convoys, activity, media, support, responsibilities and consequences.
Consolidated the Kings Player Tag, ETS2 Company Paintjob and ATS Company Paintjob guidance into one Driver Branding area (<#1558317103982055476>), making requirements easier to find and maintain.

Improved messages for accepted Driver Applications, the one-week Trial, Trial completion and confirmation as a Kings Driver. Guidance now clarifies conduct, platform rules, branding, support and optional participation. Real Life First remains a priority, and Staff opportunities remain voluntary.

The Galaxy Bot Ticket System is being reorganised with clearer panels, request categories and pre-ticket forms. Relevant information is collected before ticket creation to reduce repeated questions and improve handling for members and Staff. Rollout continues step by step.

Structured application forms now cover personal information, games and supported platforms, platform history, activity, VTC experience and other details. TruckersMP applicants may still need the separate TruckersMP VTC application; TruckersMP is not mandatory for another officially supported platform.

Reorganised support into Complaint / Report, Private Support Request and Decision Review / Appeal. Each request type collects relevant information. The review process is designed so a Staff member should not review their own original decision.

Developed structured Staff / High Staff and Management / Head Management application forms, considering Kings position, experience, motivation, skills, leadership, department development, availability and suitability. A 14-day Trial may be required depending on the role.

Created a dedicated Management Request panel for important internal, organisational, decision-related and leadership matters. The form collects the topic, details, people involved and desired outcome before a ticket opens.

Separated partnership applications from ordinary Management Requests into VTC, Convoy Control, Radio and Media / Content categories, each with its own form. The former fixed 50-member VTC minimum has been removed; applications are assessed on activity, reliability, professionalism, communication and mutual long-term value.

Private Partner channels and a shared Partner Area are being moved back to the Kings Logistics Main Server. The separate Partner Discord will no longer be needed after migration. Private Partner channels follow a consistent 'Emoji | partner-name' format.

Rebuilt structured applications for External Media and Official Streamer. These community roles allow creators to support and represent Kings without automatically receiving Staff powers, moderation permissions or confidential access.

Expanded Kings Supporter as the main recognition role for official financial support. Support methods can include Discord Boosts, future Kings Circle memberships, products and digital packs. Additional roles may identify Booster, Circle, Merch, Wear, Collectibles, Plushie and Digital Pack support. Recognition roles never grant Staff authority.

Separated Supporter Benefits from the Supporter Wall. Planned or available areas may include Supporter Lounge, Suggestions, the Wall and automatic thanks. Support never grants rule exemptions, event advantages, moderation influence or Staff permissions.

Clarified internal team responsibilities across HR, Events, Event Coordination, Design, Media, Driver Services and Development. Staff recruiting continues to focus on existing Kings Family members. Department Leadership increasingly manages its own recruitment communication.

Separated Event Coordinator (external invitations, event records and participation coordination) from Event Planner (planning Kings convoys, routes, locations, slots and event preparation). This makes responsibilities and reporting clearer.

Updated recruiting guidance for TruckersMP, HaulMP, Discord, international growth and personal invitations. Recruitment should be respectful, natural and free of spam or aggressive advertising. Poaching Drivers from other VTCs remains prohibited.

Reviewing and simplifying voice channels to reduce unnecessary duplication while maintaining useful spaces for ETS2, ATS, gaming, driving together, Drivers, official events and Staff. Some Driver-only functions may become public where appropriate.

Role Requests have become more platform-neutral, including VTC Leader, Platform Staff, Official Partner and Official Friend. Verified Staff of supported multiplayer platforms can be recognised using trustworthy profiles, websites, roles and public team information.

English remains the primary community language, but perfect English is not required. Members from all countries and time zones are welcome. Real Life First, no kilometre requirements, no mandatory convoys and no unnecessary activity pressure remain central principles.

Our first priority is to complete and improve Kings Logistics before larger future Kings projects move into active development. Remaining changes are rolling out progressively. Thank you to our Drivers, Staff, Leadership, Partners and Supporters for building the Kings Family with us! <:kings_heart:1500949819110326352>
Completed a comprehensive update of the Kings Staff Handbook, clarifying responsibilities, conduct, communication and departmental working procedures.
Reviewed and improved approximately 40 internal guides and resources across Human Resources, Events, Creative, Driver Services and Development.
Standardised guidance for Staff onboarding, departmental cooperation and leadership responsibilities.
Clarified the existing leadership structure: Operational Staff → Team Lead / Director → Management → Head Management → CEO.
Updated departmental role descriptions and improved the separation of operational Staff duties, leadership responsibilities and external community contributions.
Reviewed internal task organisation and reporting responsibilities to support clearer accountability across departments.

Standardised the external contributor opportunities External Media and Official Streamer for photographers, videographers, content creators and livestreamers who support Kings without joining internal Staff.
Defined clear boundaries for external contributors: these recognition/contributor roles do not provide Staff, Management or administrative authority.
Community application opportunities for External Media, Official Streamer and External event are available through <#1433705423285915668>.
Standardised our external convoy invitation contributor role under its official name: External event.
External event contributors support the distribution of already approved Kings Logistics convoy and event invitations using accurate event information and professional communication.
Internal Kings Events Staff retain all event planning, approvals, participation arrangements and final decisions; external contributors do not take over Event Coordinator duties.
Reorganised our regular monthly recognition into four categories: Driver of the Month, Staff of the Month, Recruiter of the Month and Photo of the Month.
Staff of the Month now recognises contributions across all internal Staff and leadership levels, while Recruiter of the Month remains an independent award.
Special Excellence Awards remain separate from the regular monthly rotation.
Improved automatic Discord Loyalty role synchronisation for eligible full Kings Drivers, with milestones at 1, 3 and 6 months and 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 years.
The system checks eligibility, maintains the highest qualifying Loyalty tier and handles outdated cosmetic Loyalty roles without changing Staff or personnel permissions.
Improved the order of Loyalty role synchronisation and Achievement notifications, and added safer recovery for delayed daily executions.
TruckersMP membership Achievements and Discord Loyalty roles use their respective joining dates; milestone levels may therefore differ.
Improved automated TruckersMP event synchronisation and the validation of convoy event information.
Fixed UTC departure-time recognition: the previously false missing-departure warnings were eliminated and the correction was confirmed in a live Convoy Checker run.
Improved handling of duplicate, delayed and incomplete event records while preserving authorised event status and slot decisions.
Improved convoy participation statistics and monthly report counting, including valid participation without a confirmed Kings parking slot.
Corrected report labels to distinguish tracked convoy entries, confirmed Kings slots, completed participation, upcoming events and excluded cancellations.
Strengthened event-ID deduplication and consistency between Convoy Center records, stored overviews and monthly reporting.
Improved the planning overview so publicly verified Kings-hosted events can be recognised from authoritative TruckersMP information.
Unclassified events now retain useful details such as public host and event reference for authorised Kings Event Staff to review.
Partner and external convoy classifications remain internal Kings decisions and are not automatically guessed from public event names.
Improved coordination, validation and recovery in the Kings automation infrastructure, including the Driver Loyalty and Convoy systems.
Fixed monitoring treatment of intentionally skipped verification callbacks while retaining alerts for genuine failures and overdue workflows.
Expanded regression coverage and successfully verified the completed technical corrections through automated system checks.
Existing safeguards against duplicate work, incorrect role changes and unauthorised personnel actions remain in place.
After reviewing the separate Partner Discord, decided to return private Partner communication to the Kings Logistics main Discord server to keep the Partner Area more central and convenient.
Clarified the organisational direction for private partner chats, shared partnership information and cooperation with official Kings partners.
Updated community-facing explanations of Staff roles, external opportunities, monthly recognition and automated Kings systems for clearer communication.
Thank you to every Driver, Staff Member, Partner, Supporter and community contributor for supporting the Kings Family and helping Kings Logistics move forward!
